title: grip.verify Request/Response
description: Schemas for the grip.verify primitive — the deterministic verification gate.

VerifyRequest.description: Request to evaluate a hypothesis against live state using loaded security rules.

liveState.description: Current property values of the resource, fetched by grip.schema.

rules.description: Security rules to evaluate, loaded by grip.security. Format is provider-native.

VerifyResponse.description: Verification gate result containing the verdict and evidence chain.

verdict.description: VERIFIED: all rules pass. VIOLATED: one or more rules failed. UNVERIFIED: no rules available for evaluation.

evidence.description: Evidence chain — one item per rule evaluated.

violationsFound.description: Number of rules that returned VIOLATED.
